meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把基因序列分析与文献检索自动化成流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理 DNA/蛋白质序列或需要批量查询 NCBI 文献与数据库。
copy.tagline_en: Automate sequence analysis and NCBI lookups in pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely handle DNA/protein sequences or need batch NCBI queries.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Biopython 的 Python 代码处理生物数据：读写 FASTA、GenBank、PDB 等文件，做序列比对、BLAST 搜索、构建系统发育树，并通过 Bio.Entrez 访问 NCBI 与 PubMed。
howto.when: 当你提到序列处理、FASTA/GenBank 文件、BLAST 等关键词，或要做批量生信分析流程时触发；只想快速查询或整合多服务时，原文建议改用 gget、bioservices。

howto.what_en: Claude writes and runs Biopython Python code for biological data: reading and writing FASTA, GenBank and PDB files, sequence alignments, BLAST searches, phylogenetic trees, and NCBI/PubMed access through Bio.Entrez.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention sequence handling, FASTA/GenBank files, BLAST, or ask for batch bioinformatics pipelines. Quick lookups belong to gget; multi-service work to bioservices.
